Once it ships, how long is delivery?
menu
Delivery times depend on the item and shipping method. Standard flooring orders ship via flat-rate curbside freight, and lead times can vary depending on whether the product is in stock or built to order. Accessories like stair nosings and transition strips typically have a lead time of about 2 to 3 weeks.
If you share your order number and email address, I can check the exact status and estimated delivery time for your specific order.

Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
We don't offer expedited production or custom rush options on orders directly, but in-stock floors ship quickly and typically arrive within 9 to 12 business days via freight. Accessories like stair nosings and transition strips are made to order and have a lead time of roughly 2 to 3 weeks.
If you provide your order number and email address, I can look up your exact items and give you a more precise update.
